title: Gulf Coast Vacation Rental 30A Beach House with Private Pool
meta_description: Bali Zen is a 5-bedroom vacation home on Florida’s Gulf Coast. Enjoy a private pool, modern amenities, and easy beach access for your perfect Emerald Coast getaway. Book now!
description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: ● Large private pool and hot tub ● Savings! Add the Street Legal Golf Cart - 10% Discount off Rate ● Close to public beach access ● Two kitchens ● Outdoor grill ● Gorgeous coastal luxury décor ● Open concert living area ● Large balconies ● Plenty of parking ● Free wifi ● Four backpack beach chairs & beach umbrella ● Close to dining, shopping, and entertainment ● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Please note: The indoor fireplace is decorative only and intended for visual enjoyment. Discover Bali Zen, a luxurious 30A vacation rental in Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A, designed to host up to 16 guests. This coastal haven offers the perfect blend of elegance and comfort, with relaxing spaces indoors and out. Start your vacation by unwinding by the private, spa-inspired pool, soaking in the heated hot tub, or savoring breathtaking sunsets from multiple balconies. Just a short distance to the beach, local shopping, and dining, Bali Zen brings together the tranquility of a private getaway with the convenience of nearby 30A attractions. The private outdoor pool area is surrounded by lush landscaping, creating a spa-like sanctuary for sunbathing, refreshing swims, or evenings spent stargazing in the hot tub. Inside, the second floor’s open-plan living area is filled with natural light streaming through large windows, showcasing the beautiful vaulted wood ceilings. Plush seating and a large flatscreen TV make it a comfortable gathering space, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, and a stunning butcher block island, is ideal for preparing meals or enjoying casual dining. An adjacent dining table seats eight, and two more bedrooms—a bunk suite with a private balcony and a king suite with another balcony—offer stylish comfort and space. The beautiful indoor fireplace is meant for visual enjoyment only and is not intended for guest use. The third-floor primary suite is a luxurious retreat with vaulted ceilings and two private balconies. Its ensuite bathroom is designed with indulgent features, including a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and elegant finishes that evoke a true spa experience. This floor provides an added level of privacy, creating a serene escape within the home. Downstairs, you'll be drawn into Bali Zen's relaxed, luxurious vibe, starting with the open-concept layout ideal for unwinding and entertaining. The first floor welcomes you with two cozy yet chic bedrooms. The king suite offers direct access to the pool area, giving you the perfect spot to step outside and enjoy the warm coastal air. The second bedroom features a fun, comfy full bunk, ideal for kids or extra guests, and both bedrooms share a sleek, modern bathroom. This floor also features a second kitchen and a bonus living area with additional twin beds, a flatscreen TV, and easy access to the patio and pool—an ideal space for families to spread out. Enjoy close access to the beach and the charming shops and eateries of Blue Mountain Beach, making it the perfect vacation spot. Whether you’re lounging by the pool, taking in coastal views from the balconies, or spending quality time with loved ones, every moment at Bali Zen promises luxury, relaxation, and unforgettable memories.
